items.title: 并列连词的逻辑关系
items.brief: 先定分句间的逻辑关系，再选对应连接词

concept.summary: 并列连词把两个语法地位相同的成分连接起来，选哪一个由分句之间的逻辑关系决定：添加用 and，转折用 but 或 yet，选择用 or，结果用 so，补充理由用 for，否定并列用 nor。两条硬约束：同一对分句不能同时出现两个连接词，如 although 与 but、because 与 so；连词两边的成分必须语法形式一致。

sections.p: 判断时先说出前后两句是什么关系，再对号入座。汉语里“和、但是、或者、所以、因为”几乎能一一对应，唯一需要留意的是 for 与 so 的方向相反。
bullets: 添加：and, both...and, not only...but also
转折：but, yet, while（对比）
选择：or（选择或“否则”）、either...or
结果：so
原因：for（补充说明依据，不能置句首）
否定并列：nor, neither...nor

sections.h: so 与 for 的方向
sections.p: so 后面是结果，for 后面是理由，两者位置不能互换。for 引导的分句只能放在结论之后，用逗号隔开，作用类似“补充说明我为什么这样说”。
bullets: so：He studied hard, so he passed the exam.（前因后果）
for：He passed the exam, for he had studied hard.（前果后因）
× For he was ill, he did not come. → He did not come, for he was ill.

sections.p: 这一结构里，and 引出顺接的好结果，or 引出相反的坏结果，相当于“否则”。选错会直接把句意反转，是选择题的高频陷阱。
bullets: Work hard, and you will succeed.（努力，你就会成功）
Hurry up, or you will miss the train.（快点，否则你会误车）
or 还可表纯选择：Would you like tea or coffee?

examples.en: He studied hard, so he passed the exam.
examples.zh: 他学习刻苦，所以通过了考试。
examples.note: so 引出结果，前一分句是原因。

examples.en: Because he studied hard, so he passed the exam.
examples.zh: 因为他学习刻苦，所以通过了考试。
examples.note: because 是从属连词，so 是并列连词，同一因果关系只能用一个，须删去 so。

examples.en: It was raining, for the streets were wet.
examples.zh: 当时在下雨，因为街道都湿了。
examples.note: for 引出推断依据，分句置于结论之后。

examples.en: For he was ill, he did not come to the meeting.
examples.zh: 因为病了，他没来开会。
examples.note: for 引导的分句只能后置，应改为 He did not come to the meeting, for he was ill.

examples.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.
examples.zh: 快点，否则你会误车。
examples.note: 祈使句 + or 表示“否则”，引出相反的坏结果。

examples.en: Hurry up, and you will miss the train.
examples.zh: 快点，你就会误车。
examples.note: and 表顺接，会得出“快点就能误车”的荒谬结论，此处须用 or。

examples.en: She is a doctor, while her brother is a lawyer.
examples.zh: 她是医生，而她弟弟是律师。
examples.note: while 在此表对比，连接两个并列分句。

examples.en: He didn't apologize, nor did he explain.
examples.zh: 他没有道歉，也没有解释。
examples.note: nor 连接否定分句，且引起部分倒装。

pitfalls.wrong: Although he was tired, but he kept working.
pitfalls.right: Although he was tired, he kept working.
pitfalls.why: although 引导让步从句，but 连接并列分句，两者功能重复，同一转折只能保留一个。

pitfalls.wrong: For he was ill, he stayed at home.
pitfalls.right: He stayed at home, for he was ill.
pitfalls.why: for 引导的分句只能放在结论之后，补充说明判断依据。

pitfalls.wrong: He is rich, and he is not happy.
pitfalls.right: He is rich, but he is not happy.
pitfalls.why: and 只表添加，前后语义相反时必须用转折连词。

contrast.withTitle: 连接副词与连词的区别
contrast.diff: 并列连词能直接用逗号连接两个分句，连接副词不能；后者必须靠分号或句号承担连接功能。

concept.mnemonic: and 加、but 转、or 选或否、so 结果、for 补理由；一个关系只用一个词。

core: 五种关系：添加 and、转折 but/yet、选择 or、结果 so、原因 for
so 前因后果，for 前果后因，且 for 只能后置
祈使句 + and 表好结果，+ or 表“否则”
同一对分句不能同时用 although 与 but、because 与 so
并列连词连接的成分必须语法形式一致
review.trigger: 看到两个分句 → 先判定是添加、转折、选择、结果还是原因 → 再检查是否已有另一个连接词

quickCheck.q: because 与 so 能同时出现吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，一个因果只保留一个连接词。

quickCheck.q: “快点，否则你会迟到”用 and 还是 or？
quickCheck.a: 用 or，表“否则”。

quickCheck.q: for 引导的分句能放在句首吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，只能放在结论之后。

drills.stem: Hurry up, ___ we will miss the opening ceremony.
drills.answer: or
drills.explain: 祈使句后接“否则会错过”的坏结果，用 or；此时 or 等于 otherwise。
drills.trap: and 是最强干扰项：祈使句 + and 表“那么就会”，会把句意变成“快点就能错过”。

drills.stem: She has never been abroad, ___ has her husband.
drills.answer: nor
accept: nor
neither
drills.hint: 后一分句是倒装语序，且与前面的否定保持一致。
drills.explain: 前句是否定，后句用 nor 或 neither 引出倒装，表示“也没有”，不能用 or 或 and。

drills.stem: Although the task was difficult, but we finished it on time.
drills.answer: Although the task was difficult, we finished it on time.
accept: Although the task was difficult, we finished it on time.
drills.explain: although 引导让步从句，已经承担了转折功能，再加并列连词 but 会造成重复，须删去 but。

drills.stem: He must be ill, ___ he looks so pale.
drills.answer: for
drills.explain: 前一分句是判断，后一分句是做出这个判断的依据，属于“前果后因”，用 for。
drills.trap: so 是强干扰项：so 要求前因后果，而这里 pale 是“他病了”的依据，方向正好相反。

drills.stem: 快点，否则你会迟到。
drills.answer: Hurry up, or you will be late.
drills.explain: 祈使句 + or 表示“否则”，引出与期望相反的结果；用 and 会把句意变成“快点就会迟到”。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She is a doctor, while her brother is a lawyer.
drills.explain: while 在此连接两个并列分句，表示两种身份的对比，前后结构完全对称。

items.title: 关联连词的主谓一致
items.brief: both...and 用复数，其余四组就近一致

concept.summary: 关联连词决定谓语单复数时有两条相反的规则：both...and 连接两个并列主语，谓语一律用复数；either...or、neither...nor、not only...but also、not...but 采用就近原则，谓语与最靠近它的那个主语一致。此外 not only 置于句首时，前一分句要部分倒装。

sections.p: both...and 把两个主语合成一个复数概念，谓语永远用复数，即使两项都是单数。这一组不用于否定句，否定要用 neither...nor。
bullets: Both the teacher and the students were surprised.
Both his father and his mother are teachers.
× Both he and I am wrong. → Both he and I are wrong.

sections.p: 这四组把两个主语并列，但谓语只看离它最近的那一个。做题时把两个主语遮挡其中一个，只留靠近谓语的那一项，就能直接读出单复数。
bullets: Neither the manager nor his assistants were informed.（就近 assistants，用复数）
Neither the assistants nor the manager was informed.（就近 manager，用单数）
Not only the students but also the teacher was excited.
Either you or he is responsible for the accident.

sections.p: not only 提到句首时，它所在的前一分句要部分倒装，把助动词或情态动词放到主语之前；but also 引导的后一分句保持正常语序。
bullets: Not only did she finish the report, but she also presented it.
Not only has he read the book, but he also remembers the details.
× Not only she finished the report... → Not only did she finish...

examples.en: Both the teacher and the students were surprised.
examples.zh: 老师和学生都很惊讶。
examples.note: both...and 连接两个主语，谓语一律用复数 were。

examples.en: Both the teacher and the students was surprised.
examples.zh: 老师和学生都很惊讶。
examples.note: both...and 视为复数概念，谓语不能用 was。

examples.en: Neither the manager nor his assistants were informed of the change.
examples.zh: 经理和助手们都没有被告知这一变动。
examples.note: neither...nor 就近，最近的主语 assistants 是复数，用 were。

examples.en: Neither the manager nor his assistants was informed of the change.
examples.zh: 经理和助手们都没有被告知这一变动。
examples.note: 就近原则要求谓语与 assistants 一致，须用 were。

examples.en: Not only the students but also the teacher was excited about the trip.
examples.zh: 不仅学生，老师也对这次旅行感到兴奋。
examples.note: not only...but also 就近，最近的主语 the teacher 是单数，用 was。

examples.en: Not only the students but also the teacher were excited about the trip.
examples.zh: 不仅学生，老师也对这次旅行感到兴奋。
examples.note: 谓语应就近与 the teacher 一致，用 was 而不是 were。

examples.en: Not only did she finish the report, but she also presented it.
examples.zh: 她不仅完成了报告，还做了汇报。
examples.note: not only 置于句首，前一分句部分倒装，助动词 did 提到主语前。

examples.en: Not only she finished the report, but she also presented it.
examples.zh: 她不仅完成了报告，还做了汇报。
examples.note: not only 在句首时前一分句必须倒装，应改为 Not only did she finish...

pitfalls.wrong: Not only the parents but also the headmaster were present.
pitfalls.right: Not only the parents but also the headmaster was present.
pitfalls.why: not only...but also 用就近原则，最近的主语 the headmaster 是单数。

pitfalls.wrong: Neither the students nor the teacher were satisfied.
pitfalls.right: Neither the students nor the teacher was satisfied.
pitfalls.why: neither...nor 用就近原则，最近的主语 teacher 是单数。

pitfalls.wrong: Not only he did apologize, but he also paid for the damage.
pitfalls.right: Not only did he apologize, but he also paid for the damage.
pitfalls.why: not only 置于句首时前一分句部分倒装，助动词须提到主语之前。

contrast.withTitle: and 连接主语的一致问题
contrast.diff: 并列连词 and 连接的两个主语一般按复数处理；本知识点处理的是带关联词的主语，其中四组改用就近原则。

concept.mnemonic: both...and 全复数；either、neither、not only 三组看最近；not only 在句首，前半句倒装。

core: both...and 连接主语，谓语一律用复数
either...or、neither...nor、not only...but also、not...but 用就近原则
就近判断法：遮住较远的主语，只看靠近谓语的那一个
not only 置于句首时前一分句部分倒装
both...and 不用于否定，否定用 neither...nor
review.trigger: 看到关联连词连接两个主语 → 先认词，both 用复数，其余四组只看最近的主语

quickCheck.q: Neither the driver nor the passengers ___ hurt. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: were，就近 passengers。

quickCheck.q: Both his father and his mother ___ teachers. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: are，both...and 用复数。

quickCheck.q: Not only 在句首要注意什么？
quickCheck.a: 前一分句要部分倒装，助动词提到主语前。

drills.stem: Neither the driver nor the passengers ___ hurt in the accident.
drills.answer: were
drills.explain: neither...nor 采用就近原则，最靠近谓语的主语 passengers 是复数，且事故发生在过去，用 were。
drills.trap: was 是最强干扰项：受 the driver 单数的影响，忽略了就近原则只看最近的主语。

drills.stem: Both my brother and my sister ___ (be) fond of jazz.
drills.answer: are
accept: are
drills.hint: 两个主语由 both...and 连接。
drills.explain: both...and 把两个单数主语合成复数概念，谓语用 are，不遵循就近原则。

drills.stem: Not only the students but also their teacher were invited to the ceremony.
drills.answer: Not only the students but also their teacher was invited to the ceremony.
accept: Not only the students but also their teacher was invited to the ceremony.
drills.explain: not only...but also 用就近原则，最靠近谓语的主语 their teacher 是单数，谓语须用 was。

drills.stem: Not only ___ the deadline, but he also delivered a better report.
drills.answer: did he meet
drills.explain: not only 位于句首，前一分句须部分倒装，把助动词 did 提到主语 he 之前，实义动词还原为原形。
drills.trap: he met 是强干扰项：语序正常，但 not only 在句首时不倒装即属语法错误。

drills.stem: 不仅学生，老师也对这次参观感到兴奋。
drills.answer: Not only the students but also the teacher was excited about the visit.
drills.explain: not only...but also 就近，最近的主语 the teacher 是单数，谓语用 was。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Both the manager and his assistant were absent.
drills.explain: both...and 连接两个单数主语构成复数概念，谓语用 were。

items.title: 从属连词与介词短语的易混
items.brief: 空后是主谓结构用连词，是名词用介词

concept.summary: 分界线只有一条：空后接的是完整的主谓结构，还是名词性成分。接从句就用从属连词 because、although、while、unless、when；接名词、代词或动名词就用介词短语 because of、despite、in spite of、during、without。判断时先看空后有没有自己的主语和谓语，再决定词性。

sections.p: 这五组意思几乎相同，差别只在后面接什么。记住成对关系，做题时先看空后结构再取词。
bullets: because + 从句 / because of + 名词
although, though, even though + 从句 / despite, in spite of + 名词
while + 从句 / during + 名词
unless + 从句 / without + 名词或动名词
when + 从句 / on + 动名词（on arriving）

sections.p: 第一步看空后是否出现主语加谓语：有则用连词。第二步若只有名词性成分，则用介词，且介词后的动词必须变成动名词。
bullets: × despite he worked hard → despite his hard work / although he worked hard
× because of it rained → because it rained / because of the rain
× without he said goodbye → without saying goodbye

sections.h: 语义相同不等于可以直接换
sections.p: 介词短语与从句可以互相改写，但改写时必须补出或删去主语和谓语，不能只替换一个词。改写的方向决定句子结构，不是两个词的自由互换。
bullets: despite the rain = although it rained
during the lecture = while the lecture was going on
because of his illness = because he was ill

examples.en: Although the weather was bad, the match went on.
examples.zh: 虽然天气不好，比赛照常进行。
examples.note: 空后是完整从句 the weather was bad，用从属连词 although。

examples.en: Despite the weather was bad, the match went on.
examples.zh: 虽然天气不好，比赛照常进行。
examples.note: despite 是介词，只能带名词性成分，此处应改为 Although the weather was bad 或 Despite the bad weather。

examples.en: He was absent because of a family emergency.
examples.zh: 他因家中急事缺席。
examples.note: a family emergency 是名词短语，用介词短语 because of。

examples.en: He was absent because a family emergency.
examples.zh: 他因家中急事缺席。
examples.note: because 后必须接从句，此处只有名词短语，应改为 because of。

examples.en: During the lecture, several students took notes.
examples.zh: 讲座期间，几名学生做了笔记。
examples.note: the lecture 是名词短语，表示“在…期间”用介词 during。

examples.en: While the lecture, several students took notes.
examples.zh: 讲座期间，几名学生做了笔记。
examples.note: while 是从属连词，必须引导从句，此处应改为 During the lecture。

examples.en: She finished the report without asking for help.
examples.zh: 她没求助就完成了报告。
examples.note: without 是介词，后面接动名词 asking。

examples.en: He left without he said goodbye.
examples.zh: 他没说再见就离开了。
examples.note: without 是介词，不能接从句，应改为 without saying goodbye。

pitfalls.wrong: Despite he worked hard, he failed the test.
pitfalls.right: Although he worked hard, he failed the test.
pitfalls.why: despite 是介词，只能带名词性成分；空后是完整从句，须换成从属连词 although。

pitfalls.wrong: Because of the traffic was heavy, we were late.
pitfalls.right: Because the traffic was heavy, we were late.
pitfalls.why: because of 后不能接从句，the traffic was heavy 有主语和谓语，须改用 because。

pitfalls.wrong: While the holiday, the museum is crowded.
pitfalls.right: During the holiday, the museum is crowded.
pitfalls.why: while 必须引导从句；只有名词短语 the holiday 时用介词 during。

contrast.withTitle: 表示原因与理由的介词
contrast.diff: 本知识点判断“用连词还是介词短语”，原因介词那一点判断“在介词里选哪一个”，前者看空后结构，后者看原因的性质。

concept.mnemonic: 空后有主谓，选连词；空后只有名词，选介词；介词后面跟动词，一律变 doing。

core: 判定只看空后：有主谓结构用连词，只有名词性成分用介词
because / because of；although / despite；while / during；unless / without
介词后的动词必须用动名词：without saying goodbye
介词短语与从句改写时要补出或删去主语谓语
while 后不能只跟名词，during 后不能跟从句
review.trigger: 看到空 → 先扫一遍空后有没有主语和谓语 → 有则连词，无则介词

quickCheck.q: despite 后面能接句子吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，despite 是介词，须接名词或动名词。

quickCheck.q: “在讲座期间”用 during 还是 while？
quickCheck.a: the lecture 是名词短语，用 during the lecture。

quickCheck.q: without 后面的动词用什么形式？
quickCheck.a: 动名词，如 without asking for help。

drills.stem: ___ the heavy snow, all the flights were cancelled.
drills.answer: Because of
drills.explain: 空后只有名词短语 the heavy snow，没有主谓结构，只能用介词短语 because of。
drills.trap: Because 是最强干扰项：它必须引导完整从句，不能直接带名词短语。

drills.stem: He failed the exam ___ of his laziness.
drills.answer: because
accept: because
drills.hint: 空后是 of + 名词，说明这里需要一个能与 of 搭配的词。
drills.explain: because of 是固定介词短语，意为“由于”，of 不能单独承担这一功能。

drills.stem: Despite the weather was terrible, the ceremony went on as planned.
drills.answer: Although the weather was terrible, the ceremony went on as planned.
accept: Although the weather was terrible, the ceremony went on as planned.
Though the weather was terrible, the ceremony went on as planned.
Despite the terrible weather, the ceremony went on as planned.
drills.explain: despite 是介词，只能带名词性成分；空后 the weather was terrible 是完整从句，须改用连词 although，或把从句压缩成名词短语。

drills.stem: ___ the meeting, he took detailed notes.
drills.answer: During
drills.explain: 空后只有名词短语 the meeting，表示“在…期间”须用介词 during。
drills.trap: While 是强干扰项：while 必须引导从句，后面不能只跟一个名词短语。

drills.stem: 尽管很累，他还是完成了工作。
drills.answer: Although he was tired, he finished the work.
drills.explain: 空后需要完整从句，用从属连词 although；despite 是介词，只能接名词性成分。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He was absent because of a family emergency.
drills.explain: a family emergency 是名词短语，用 because of；若换成从句则须改写为 because his family had an emergency。

items.title: 时间状语连词 before/after/until/when/while/as
items.brief: 按两个动作的先后、并行、持续选连词

concept.summary: 选哪个时间连词取决于两个动作的时间关系：同时且都在持续用 while；同时发生并带“随着、一边…一边”的并行或变化用 as；一个动作在另一个时点发生用 when；有明显先后用 before 或 after；一直持续到某个终点用 until。所有时间状语从句都遵守主将从现，用一般现在时或现在完成时表示将来。

sections.p: 三者都可能译成“当…时”，区别在动作性质：when 兼容瞬间与延续，还可表示“就在这时”；while 强调一段时间的持续，从句动词必须能延续；as 强调两个动作同步推进或同步变化。
bullets: when：When he arrived, we were having dinner.（arrive 是瞬间动词）
while：While I was reading, my brother was watching TV.（两个持续动作）
as：As time went by, he grew more confident.（同步变化）
be about to do ... when：I was about to leave when the phone rang.

sections.p: before 与 after 只标记先后，主从句时态按实际时间安排。until 标记持续的终点，谓语必须是延续性动词；瞬间动词要把句子改成否定式，构成 not...until，表示“直到…才”。
bullets: She cleaned the room before the guests arrived.
Wait here until I come back.（wait 延续）
He didn't go to bed until he finished the report.（go to bed 瞬间，故用否定）

sections.p: 时间状语从句不用 will 表示将来，而用一般现在时或现在完成时；主句才用将来时。这条规则同样适用于条件状语从句。
bullets: I will call you when I arrive.（不是 when I will arrive）
We will start as soon as the rain has stopped.
× I will tell him when I will see him.

examples.en: While I was reading, my brother was watching TV.
examples.zh: 我在看书的时候，弟弟在看电视。
examples.note: 两个动作同时持续，用 while 引导从句。

examples.en: While the phone rang, I was cooking dinner.
examples.zh: 电话响的时候，我正在做晚饭。
examples.note: rang 是瞬间动作，while 要求从句动词可以延续，应改为 When the phone rang。

examples.en: As time went by, he grew more confident.
examples.zh: 随着时间推移，他变得越来越自信。
examples.note: 两个变化同步推进，用 as 表示“随着”。

examples.en: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我正要出门，这时电话响了。
examples.note: be about to do ... when 是固定结构，when 表“就在这时”。

examples.en: I will call you when I will arrive.
examples.zh: 我到了就给你打电话。
examples.note: 时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来，应改为 when I arrive。

examples.en: He didn't go to bed until he finished the report.
examples.zh: 他直到写完报告才去睡觉。
examples.note: go to bed 是瞬间动作，与 until 连用须用否定式 not...until。

examples.en: He went to bed until he finished the report.
examples.zh: 他直到写完报告才去睡觉。
examples.note: 肯定式的 went to bed 无法持续到某点，须改为 didn't go to bed until。

examples.en: She cleaned the room before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 她在客人到之前打扫了房间。
examples.note: before 标记先后，主句动作先发生。

pitfalls.wrong: While he arrived, we were having dinner.
pitfalls.right: When he arrived, we were having dinner.
pitfalls.why: arrive 是瞬间动词，while 要求从句动作表示持续状态，瞬间动作用 when。

pitfalls.wrong: I will tell him the news as soon as I will see him.
pitfalls.right: I will tell him the news as soon as I see him.
pitfalls.why: 时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来，不能出现 will。

pitfalls.wrong: He left until midnight.
pitfalls.right: He didn't leave until midnight.
pitfalls.why: leave 是瞬间动词，与 until 连用须用否定式，表示“直到…才”。

contrast.withTitle: 时间状语从句 when/while/as 的辨析
contrast.diff: 本知识点把 when/while/as 放进 before/after/until 的完整体系中按时间关系选词，那一处只对比三者内部的差别。

concept.mnemonic: 同时持续用 while，同步变化用 as，瞬间时点用 when；until 要延续，瞬间就否定。

core: while 要求从句动作持续，瞬间动词用 when
as 强调两个动作同步推进或同步变化
be about to do ... when 表“就在这时”
before / after 只标记先后，时态按实际时间安排
until 要求延续性动词，瞬间动词须用 not...until
时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来
review.trigger: 看到两个动作 → 先判同时还是先后 → 再判是否持续、是否瞬间

quickCheck.q: While the phone rang 对吗？
quickCheck.a: 不对，rang 是瞬间动作，应改为 When the phone rang。

quickCheck.q: “他直到午夜才离开”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: He didn't leave until midnight。

quickCheck.q: 时间状语从句能出现 will 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，用一般现在时表将来。

drills.stem: ___ the phone rang, I was taking a shower.
drills.answer: When
drills.explain: rang 是瞬间动作，不能构成一段持续的时间，因此用 when 引导从句。
drills.trap: While 是最强干扰项：主句是进行时，容易被误判为“正在进行”，但 while 要求从句动词本身能延续。

drills.stem: I will send you the file as soon as I ___ (get) to the office.
drills.answer: get
accept: get
drills.hint: 时间状语从句表示将来，但谓语形式要变。
drills.explain: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，用一般现在时表将来，get 不加 will，也不用 gets。

drills.stem: He went to bed until he finished all the work.
drills.answer: He didn't go to bed until he finished all the work.
accept: He didn't go to bed until he finished all the work.
drills.explain: go to bed 是瞬间动作，不能持续到某点，须改为否定结构 not...until，表示“直到…才”。

drills.stem: ___ time passed, the small town changed beyond recognition.
drills.answer: As
drills.explain: 两个变化同步推进，as 表示“随着”，是这一语义的固定选择。
drills.trap: While 是强干扰项：while 只表示两个持续动作并存，不能表达“随着…而变化”的同步推进关系。

drills.stem: 直到雨停，我们才离开。
drills.answer: We didn't leave until the rain stopped.
drills.explain: leave 是瞬间动词，与 until 连用须采用否定结构 not...until，表示“直到…才”。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
drills.explain: be about to do ... when 是固定结构，when 在此表示“就在这时”，引出突然发生的动作。

items.title: 因果与让步连词的语义差异
items.brief: 因果看已知与否，让步看事实还是假设

concept.summary: 因果连词按“原因是不是听话人已知的信息”分层：because 提供新信息、语气最强，可作强调句的焦点；since 与 as 表示“既然、由于”，原因被视为已知前提；for 是并列连词，只补充推断依据。让步连词按“事实还是假设”分层：although 与 though 承认既成事实，even though 强调事实确实如此，even if 表示假设未必成立；as 引导让步必须倒装。

sections.p: because 回答 why，是信息的核心，因此可以被强调句聚焦；since 与 as 把原因当作双方已知的背景，重点在后面的结论，不能用来回答 why 的焦点问句。
bullets: because：He was late because the bus broke down.（回答 why）
强调句：It was because the bus broke down that he was late.
since / as：Since you are already here, you may as well stay.
× Why are you late? Since the bus broke down. → Because the bus broke down.

sections.p: although、though、even though 都承认一个事实成立，然后说结果与预期相反；even if 则把条件当作假设，事实未必如此。两者互换会改变预设，是选择题的核心考点。
bullets: Even though he was ill, he came to the meeting.（他确实病了）
Even if it rains tomorrow, the match will go on.（明天未必下雨）
although 与 though 可互换，though 还可置于句末：It was a good try, though.

sections.h: as 引导让步必须倒装
sections.p: as 表让步时要把表语、状语或动词原形提到主语之前，构成倒装；不倒装时 as 会被读成“因为”，句子意思随之改变。though 也可用于同样的倒装结构。
bullets: Tired as he was, he kept working.
Much as I respect him, I cannot agree with him.
× Tired although he was, he kept working.（although 不用于倒装）

sections.p: 让步从句不能与 but 并存，但可以与 yet、still 并存；因果从句不能与 so 并存。这类叠加在改错题中出现频率极高。
bullets: × Although he was tired, but he kept working.
√ Although he was tired, yet he kept working.
× Because he was ill, so he stayed at home.

examples.en: He was late because the bus broke down.
examples.zh: 他迟到是因为公交车抛锚了。
examples.note: because 提供新信息，回答“为什么”。

examples.en: Since you are already here, you may as well stay for dinner.
examples.zh: 既然你已经来了，不妨留下吃饭。
examples.note: since 把原因当作双方已知的前提，重点在后面的建议。

examples.en: Why are you late? Since the bus broke down.
examples.zh: 你为什么迟到？因为公交车抛锚了。
examples.note: since 不能回答 why 的焦点问句，此处须用 Because the bus broke down.

examples.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, the match will go on.
examples.zh: 即使明天下雨，比赛也照常进行。
examples.note: 明天下雨只是假设，用 even if。

examples.en: Even though he was ill, he came to the meeting.
examples.zh: 尽管他病了，还是来开会了。
examples.note: 他生病是既成事实，用 even though 承认这一事实。

examples.en: Even though it rains tomorrow, the match will go on.
examples.zh: 虽然明天下雨，比赛也照常进行。
examples.note: 明天是否下雨尚未确定，even though 预设事实成立，应改为 Even if it rains tomorrow。

examples.en: Tired as he was, he kept working.
examples.zh: 尽管很累，他还是继续工作。
examples.note: as 引导让步时表语提前构成倒装，全句意为“尽管他很累”。

examples.en: Tired although he was, he kept working.
examples.zh: 尽管很累，他还是继续工作。
examples.note: 让步倒装只能用 as 或 though，although 不能用于这种前置结构。

pitfalls.wrong: Since you are tired, so you should rest.
pitfalls.right: Since you are tired, you should rest.
pitfalls.why: since 是从属连词，so 是并列连词，同一因果关系只能用一个。

pitfalls.wrong: Even though it will rain tomorrow, we will go hiking.
pitfalls.right: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will go hiking.
pitfalls.why: even though 预设事实成立，even if 才表假设；且条件从句用一般现在时表将来。

pitfalls.wrong: Tired although he was, he kept working.
pitfalls.right: Tired as he was, he kept working.
pitfalls.why: 让步倒装只由 as 或 though 引导，although 没有这种用法。

contrast.diff: 本知识点比较因果与让步两套连词的分层依据，那一处专门列举让步从句的全部引导词与倒装形式。

concept.mnemonic: because 答 why，since 讲既然；even though 是事实，even if 是假设；as 让步必倒装。

core: because 回答 why，可作强调句焦点；since / as 的原因视为已知
for 只补充推断依据，不作回答 why 的焦点
even though 预设事实成立，even if 表假设
as 引导让步必须倒装：Tired as he was...
让步不与 but 并存，可与 yet / still 并存；因果不与 so 并存
review.trigger: 看到原因 → 先判是不是回答 why；看到让步 → 先判是事实还是假设

quickCheck.q: Why are you late? 能用 Since... 回答吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，须用 Because，since 的原因被视为已知信息。

quickCheck.q: Even though 与 even if 的区别是什么？
quickCheck.a: 前者预设事实成立，后者表假设未必成立。

quickCheck.q: “尽管很累”用 as 怎么表达？
quickCheck.a: Tired as he was，表语提前构成倒装。

drills.stem: ___ it rains tomorrow, the ceremony will be held indoors.
drills.answer: Even if
drills.explain: 明天下雨只是一种假设，结果尚未确定，表示“即使”用 even if。
drills.trap: Even though 是最强干扰项：它预设“下雨”已经成立，与 tomorrow 的未来语境冲突。

drills.stem: Tired ___ he was, he refused to take a break.
drills.answer: as
accept: as
though
drills.hint: 表语 tired 已提到句首，说明这里要用能构成让步倒装的词。
drills.explain: as 或 though 引导让步时须把表语提前，构成 Tired as he was 这一倒装结构。

drills.stem: Since you have no experience, so you should start with small tasks.
drills.answer: Since you have no experience, you should start with small tasks.
accept: Since you have no experience, you should start with small tasks.
drills.explain: since 已承担因果引导功能，再加并列连词 so 会造成重复，须删去 so。

drills.stem: ___ he had trained for months, he still lost the final.
drills.answer: Although
drills.explain: 训练了几个月却仍然输了，前后是让步关系，用 although 引导让步从句。
drills.trap: Because 是强干扰项：它表因果，与 still 所表达的“出乎预期”直接冲突。

drills.stem: 即使明天下雨，比赛也照常进行。
drills.answer: Even if it rains tomorrow, the match will go on as planned.
drills.explain: 明天下雨是假设，用 even if；条件从句用一般现在时 rains 表将来，不用 will rain。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Even if it rains, the match will go on.
drills.explain: even if 引导假设条件，从句用一般现在时 rains，主句用将来时 will go on。

items.title: 条件连词 if/unless/provided that
items.brief: unless 已含否定，条件从句不用 will

concept.summary: 条件连词的分工由条件的性质决定：if 引出一般条件；unless 是唯一的否定条件，等于 if...not，从句本身不再带否定；provided that 与 on condition that 引出“只有…才”的书面条件；as long as 引出“只要”的必要条件；in case 引出“以防”的预防性条件。所有条件从句用一般现在时或现在完成时表将来，不用 will。

sections.p: unless 相当于 if...not，因此后面的从句必须是肯定形式。再加一个否定词就构成双重否定，句意会反转到原意的对立面。
bullets: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train. = If you don't hurry, ...
× Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the train.
unless 可用于虚拟或真实条件，但不能引导宾语从句

sections.p: provided that、providing that、on condition that 语气最严格，表示“只有满足这个条件才行”；as long as 表示“只要”，强调这是唯一必要条件；in case 表示“以防”，后面的动作是预防措施。
bullets: You may borrow the car provided that you return it by Sunday.
As long as you keep practising, you will improve.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.（in case of + 名词）

sections.h: 主将从现与唯一的例外
sections.p: 条件从句用一般现在时表将来：If it rains, we will cancel. 但当 if 引导的是宾语从句、意为“是否”时，可以用将来时，因为它已经不再是条件从句。
bullets: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
× If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
I don't know if he will join us.（宾语从句，可用 will）

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就取消野餐。
examples.note: 条件从句用一般现在时 rains 表将来。

examples.en: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就取消野餐。
examples.note: 条件从句不能用 will 表将来，应改为 If it rains tomorrow。

examples.en: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.
examples.zh: 除非你快点，否则你会误车。
examples.note: unless 等于 if...not，从句用肯定形式 hurry。

examples.en: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the train.
examples.zh: 除非你不快点，否则你会误车。
examples.note: unless 本身已含否定，再加 don't 构成双重否定，须删去 don't。

examples.en: You may borrow the car provided that you return it by Sunday.
examples.zh: 只要你周日之前归还，就可以借这辆车。
examples.note: provided that 引出书面条件，语气比 if 更严格。

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
examples.zh: 带把伞，以防下雨。
examples.note: in case 引出预防性条件，从句用一般现在时表将来。

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it will rain.
examples.zh: 带把伞，以防下雨。
examples.note: in case 从句与条件从句一样用一般现在时，应改为 in case it rains。

examples.en: I don't know if he will join us.
examples.zh: 我不知道他是否会加入我们。
examples.note: 此处 if 引导宾语从句，意为“是否”，可以用将来时。

pitfalls.wrong: Unless you don't study hard, you will fail.
pitfalls.right: Unless you study hard, you will fail.
pitfalls.why: unless 本身等于 if...not，再加 don't 就变成双重否定，句意反转为“只有不努力才会失败”。

pitfalls.wrong: If he will come, tell me.
pitfalls.right: If he comes, tell me.
pitfalls.why: 条件从句用一般现在时表将来，不能出现 will。

pitfalls.wrong: I will take a taxi in case I will be late.
pitfalls.right: I will take a taxi in case I am late.
pitfalls.why: in case 从句与条件从句同规则，用一般现在时表将来。

contrast.diff: 本知识点比较 if、unless、provided that、in case 的语义差别，那一处列举条件从句的全部引导词与时态规则。

concept.mnemonic: unless 自带 not，从句不再否；条件从句表将来，一律用现在。

core: unless = if...not，从句用肯定形式，不能再加否定词
provided that / on condition that 表“只有…才”，语气最严格
as long as 表“只要”，是唯一必要条件
in case 表“以防”，in case of 后接名词
条件从句用一般现在时表将来；if 引导宾语从句表“是否”时可用 will
review.trigger: 看到条件从句 → 先查有没有 will，再看 unless 后面是否多了一个否定词

quickCheck.q: Unless you don't hurry 对吗？
quickCheck.a: 不对，unless 已含否定，应改为 Unless you hurry。

quickCheck.q: If it will rain tomorrow 对吗？
quickCheck.a: 不对，条件从句用一般现在时，应改为 If it rains tomorrow。

quickCheck.q: “以防下雨”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: in case it rains，或 in case of rain。

drills.stem: ___ you book the tickets in advance, you will not get a seat.
drills.answer: Unless
drills.explain: 主句是否定结果，从句需要表达“如果不提前订票”，用含否定意义的 unless。
drills.trap: If 是最强干扰项：if 表肯定条件，与主句的 not 连读会变成“如果订票就买不到座位”。

drills.stem: You can stay here as ___ as you keep the room tidy.
drills.answer: long
accept: long
drills.hint: as ... as 中间填一个形容词，构成“只要”。
drills.explain: as long as 是固定搭配，意为“只要”，引出唯一必要条件。

drills.stem: Unless you don't apologize, she will never forgive you.
drills.answer: Unless you apologize, she will never forgive you.
accept: Unless you apologize, she will never forgive you.
drills.explain: unless 已经包含否定意义，再加 don't 构成双重否定，句意反转，须删去 don't。

drills.stem: I will lend you the book ___ that you return it next week.
drills.answer: provided
drills.explain: provided that 表示“只有…才”，与“下周归还才借给你”的严格条件相符。
drills.trap: in case 是强干扰项：in case 表“以防”，是预防措施，不是交换条件。

drills.stem: 如果明天天气好，我们就去爬山。
drills.answer: If the weather is fine tomorrow, we will go hiking.
drills.explain: 条件从句用一般现在时 is 表将来，主句才用 will；不能写成 if the weather will be fine。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.
drills.explain: unless 引导否定条件，从句用肯定形式 hurry，主句用将来时 will miss。

items.title: 连接副词与连词的区别
items.brief: 连接副词不是连词，须用分号或句号

concept.summary: however、therefore、moreover、otherwise、nevertheless 这类词在语义上像连词，在语法上却是副词：它们没有连接两个分句的功能，不能像 but、so 那样只用逗号连接两个句子。正确写法是分号加连接副词加逗号，或者用句号断开另起一句。判定方法很直接：把逗号换成句号，句子仍成立，说明此处只能用连接副词。

sections.h: 为什么不能用逗号连接
sections.p: 逗号只表示停顿，不表示连接。连词本身具备连接功能，可以承担两个分句之间的关系；连接副词只修饰自己所在的句子，关系必须由分号或句号承担。只用逗号会形成逗号粘连。
bullets: √ He was tired, but he kept working.（but 是连词）
× He was tired, however he kept working.（逗号粘连）
√ He was tired; however, he kept working.
√ He was tired. However, he kept working.

sections.h: 常用连接副词与对应连词
sections.p: 每一类逻辑关系都有“连词版”和“连接副词版”，写作时按语体选择：连词更口语，连接副词更书面。
bullets: 转折：however, nevertheless ↔ but, yet
结果：therefore, thus, hence ↔ so
递进：moreover, furthermore, besides ↔ and, in addition
选择与否则：otherwise ↔ or
同时：meanwhile, at the same time

sections.p: 连接副词在句中的位置比连词自由，可置于句首、句中或句末；句首时后面通常加逗号，句中时前后各一个逗号。它不能与同一逻辑关系的连词叠加使用。
bullets: 句首：However, the plan failed.
句中：The plan, however, failed.
句末（口语）：The plan failed, however.
× but however；× although ... however

examples.en: The plan was expensive; however, it was the only workable one.
examples.zh: 这个方案很贵，但它是唯一可行的。
examples.note: 分号承担连接功能，however 后的逗号标记它的插入位置。

examples.en: The plan was expensive, however, it was the only workable one.
examples.zh: 这个方案很贵，但它是唯一可行的。
examples.note: however 是连接副词，不能只用逗号连接两个分句，须改为分号或句号。

examples.en: He had no money. Therefore, he could not buy the ticket.
examples.zh: 他没有钱，因此买不起票。
examples.note: 用句号断开，therefore 另起一句，符合连接副词的用法。

examples.en: The rent is high; moreover, the flat is far from the station.
examples.zh: 房租高，而且公寓离车站远。
examples.note: moreover 表递进，用分号与前句隔开。

examples.en: He was tired, but however he kept working.
examples.zh: 他很累，但仍然继续工作。
examples.note: but 与 however 都表转折，叠加使用造成冗余，保留一个即可。

examples.en: Leave now; otherwise, you will miss the train.
examples.zh: 现在就走，否则你会误车。
examples.note: otherwise 相当于 or，用分号隔开两个分句。

examples.en: She trained hard, therefore she won the race.
examples.zh: 她训练刻苦，因此赢了比赛。
examples.note: therefore 不能只用逗号连接分句，应改为分号加逗号，或用 so。

examples.en: The weather was bad; nevertheless, the match went on.
examples.zh: 天气不好，然而比赛照常进行。
examples.note: nevertheless 表转折，用分号连接并加逗号。

pitfalls.wrong: She studied hard, however she failed the exam.
pitfalls.right: She studied hard; however, she failed the exam.
pitfalls.why: however 是连接副词，没有连接功能，逗号会造成粘连，须用分号或句号。

pitfalls.wrong: The weather was bad, therefore the match was cancelled.
pitfalls.right: The weather was bad; therefore, the match was cancelled.
pitfalls.why: therefore 同样是连接副词，不能替代 so 用逗号连接两个分句。

pitfalls.wrong: Although it was late, however we continued.
pitfalls.right: Although it was late, we continued.
pitfalls.why: although 已表转折，however 再表转折即重复，同一关系只保留一个标记。

contrast.diff: 两者逻辑关系相同，差别在语法功能：连词能直接用逗号连接分句，连接副词必须依靠分号或句号。

concept.mnemonic: however 不是 but，therefore 不是 so；中间要分号，或者干脆断句。

core: however / therefore / moreover / otherwise / nevertheless 都是连接副词
连接副词无连接功能，不能只用逗号连接两个分句
正确标点：分号 + 连接副词 + 逗号，或句号另起一句
位置灵活：句首、句中、句末皆可
不能与同义连词叠加：× but however
review.trigger: 看到 however、therefore 前只有逗号 → 立刻改成分号或句号

quickCheck.q: however 能像 but 一样用逗号连接两个句子吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，须用分号或句号。

quickCheck.q: therefore 对应的连词是什么？
quickCheck.a: so。

quickCheck.q: but however 能连用吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，两者都表转折，重复。

drills.stem: The hotel was far from the centre; ___, it was clean and quiet.
drills.answer: however
drills.explain: 空处位于分号之后、逗号之前，只能填连接副词；however 表转折，与“远但干净安静”吻合。
drills.trap: but 是强干扰项：but 是连词，应直接跟在逗号后连接分句，不能放在分号加逗号的位置。

drills.stem: Leave now; ___, you will miss the train.
drills.answer: otherwise
accept: otherwise
drills.hint: 空处表示“否则”，相当于 or，但它是副词。
drills.explain: otherwise 意为“否则”，在分号后作连接副词，与前句构成“做某事，否则会…”的关系。

drills.stem: She trained hard, however she did not win the race.
drills.answer: She trained hard; however, she did not win the race.
accept: She trained hard; however, she did not win the race.
She trained hard. However, she did not win the race.
drills.explain: however 是连接副词，不能只用逗号连接两个分句，须改分号为分号或句号，并补上 however 后的逗号。

drills.stem: 下列哪一句的标点与连接词搭配正确？
options: The road was icy, therefore we drove slowly.
The road was icy; therefore, we drove slowly.
The road was icy, therefore, we drove slowly.
The road was icy therefore, we drove slowly.
drills.answer: The road was icy; therefore, we drove slowly.
drills.explain: therefore 是连接副词，必须用分号或句号与前句隔开，它后面再加逗号。
drills.trap: 第三句是强干扰项：两个逗号看似把 therefore 括了起来，实际仍是用逗号连接两个分句，属粘连。

drills.stem: 他很累，但仍然继续工作。
drills.answer: He was tired; however, he kept working.
drills.explain: however 是连接副词，须用分号与前句隔开；若用 but，则应写成 He was tired, but he kept working.

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The plan was expensive; however, it was the only option.
drills.explain: 分号承担连接功能，however 后接逗号，构成标准的“分号 + 连接副词 + 逗号”格式。

items.title: 连词误用导致的句子残缺
items.brief: 数谓语、查引导词，判断是否缺主句

concept.summary: 一个完整句子必须有一个不带引导词的主句，从句只能依附于主句。判定分三步：数出全部谓语；看每个谓语前是否有连词引导；若所有谓语都被引导，说明缺主句，句子残缺。常见的三种破坏方式是：从句单独成句、两个主句只用逗号粘连、连词重复或成分不平行。

sections.h: 残缺：只有从句没有主句
sections.p: although、because、when、if、while、since 引导的从句不能独立成句，它需要一个主句来承载主要信息。句号一旦把它与主句切开，剩下的就是一个残缺片段。
bullets: × Although he was exhausted. He finished the race.
√ Although he was exhausted, he finished the race.
√ He was exhausted. He finished the race anyway.（去掉连词即可独立）

sections.h: 粘连：两个主句只有逗号
sections.p: 两个都能独立成句的分句之间，必须用并列连词、分号或句号连接。只用逗号会造成逗号粘连，这也是连词缺失的一种表现。
bullets: × The road was closed, we took a detour.
√ The road was closed, so we took a detour.
√ The road was closed; we took a detour.

sections.p: 结构完整但连词重复，同样判为错误：reason 与 because 语义重复，although 与 but 功能重复。连词两边的成分还须语法形式一致，动名词不能与不定式并列。
bullets: × The reason is because he was late. → The reason is that he was late.
× Although he was tired, but he kept working.
× He likes swimming and to run. → He likes swimming and running.

examples.en: Although he was exhausted, he finished the race.
examples.zh: 尽管筋疲力尽，他还是跑完了比赛。
examples.note: 从句与主句用逗号连接，构成一个完整句子。

examples.en: Although he was exhausted. He finished the race.
examples.zh: 尽管筋疲力尽。他跑完了比赛。
examples.note: although 引导的从句没有主句依附，句号把它切成了残缺句，应改用逗号连接。

examples.en: The reason he left is that he found a better job.
examples.zh: 他离开的原因是他找到了更好的工作。
examples.note: 表语从句用 that 引导，避免与 reason 语义重复。

examples.en: The reason he left is because he found a better job.
examples.zh: 他离开的原因是因为他找到了更好的工作。
examples.note: reason 与 because 都表原因，语义重复，表语从句须用 that。

examples.en: He likes swimming and running.
examples.zh: 他喜欢游泳和跑步。
examples.note: and 连接两个动名词，形式完全平行。

examples.en: He likes swimming and to run.
examples.zh: 他喜欢游泳和跑步。
examples.note: and 两边的成分形式不一致，动名词不能与不定式并列，应改为 running。

examples.en: Because the road was closed, we took a detour.
examples.zh: 因为道路封闭，我们绕道而行。
examples.note: because 引导从句，主句紧随其后，结构完整。

examples.en: Because the road was closed, so we took a detour.
examples.zh: 因为道路封闭，所以我们绕道而行。
examples.note: because 与 so 功能重复，同一因果关系只能用一个，须删去 so。

pitfalls.wrong: Although the weather was bad. The match went on.
pitfalls.right: Although the weather was bad, the match went on.
pitfalls.why: although 引导的是从句，必须有主句依附；句号把主句切断，留下一个残缺片段。

pitfalls.wrong: The reason why he was late is because he missed the bus.
pitfalls.right: The reason why he was late is that he missed the bus.
pitfalls.why: reason 与 because 都表原因，语义重复；表语从句用 that 引导。

pitfalls.wrong: He enjoys reading, and to write poems.
pitfalls.right: He enjoys reading and writing poems.
pitfalls.why: and 连接的成分必须语法形式一致，动名词不能与不定式并列。

contrast.withTitle: 从属连词与介词短语的易混
contrast.diff: 本知识点判断句子是否完整，那一点判断空格该填连词还是介词，前者看全句结构，后者只看空后成分。

concept.mnemonic: 数谓语、找引导词；全被引导就是残缺，全靠逗号就是粘连。

core: 完整句 = 一个无引导词的主句 + 若干从句或短语
三步判定：数谓语 → 查每个谓语前有无引导词 → 判断是否缺主句
从句单独成句是残缺，两个主句只用逗号是粘连
The reason is that...，不用 because
连词两边成分必须语法形式一致
review.trigger: 看到句号前是 although / because / when 引导的从句 → 立刻检查后半句是否被切开

quickCheck.q: Although he was tired. 这句话完整吗？
quickCheck.a: 不完整，是从句，需要主句依附。

quickCheck.q: The reason is because... 有什么问题？
quickCheck.a: reason 与 because 语义重复，应改为 The reason is that...

quickCheck.q: He likes swimming and to run. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: and 两边形式不一致，应改为 swimming and running。

drills.stem: ___ he had prepared carefully, he still felt nervous before the speech.
drills.answer: Although
drills.explain: 准备了很久却仍然紧张，前后是让步关系；although 引导让步从句，主句用 he still felt nervous。
drills.trap: Because 是强干扰项：它表因果，与 still 所暗示的“出乎预期”冲突。

drills.stem: The reason she resigned is ___ the working hours were too long.
drills.answer: that
accept: that
drills.hint: 表语从句的引导词，避免与 reason 语义重复。
drills.explain: reason 已表达“原因”，表语从句用 that 引导即可；用 because 会造成语义重复。

drills.stem: Because the flight was delayed, so we missed the connection.
drills.answer: Because the flight was delayed, we missed the connection.
accept: Because the flight was delayed, we missed the connection.
drills.explain: because 已承担因果引导功能，再加并列连词 so 造成重复，须删去 so。

drills.stem: 下列哪一句是结构完整的句子？
options: The train was late, so we missed the connection.
drills.answer: The train was late, so we missed the connection.
drills.explain: 这一句由两个主句加并列连词 so 构成，谓语都有归属，结构完整。
drills.trap: 第一句是强干扰项：although 引导的从句没有主句依附，是典型的残缺句。

drills.stem: 他迟到的原因是他错过了公交车。
drills.answer: The reason why he was late is that he missed the bus.
drills.explain: reason 已表原因，表语从句须用 that 引导；用 because 会与 reason 语义重复。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Although it was raining, the children played outside.
drills.explain: although 引导让步从句，与主句用逗号连接，构成一个完整句子；不能在两半之间加句号。
